member.summary: Owns logger context, independent output admission and one shared bounded stop operation.

member.name: M:CIS.Logging.CoreLogRuntime.Create
member.summary: Creates an application-owned runtime using the prepared static environment settings and automatically captured facts.
member.remarks: Configure EnvironmentOptions.Logging before creation; preparation normalizes its FilePath in place. Concurrent mutation of those settings is unsupported. Each runtime owns only its own workers and file group. DisposeAsync joins its bounded shutdown.
member.exception: Module settings or captured metadata are invalid.

member.name: M:CIS.Logging.CoreLogRuntime.StopAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Starts or joins one shared bounded stop operation through its original accepted boundaries.
member.param: Cancels only this caller's wait; even an already-cancelled first caller starts shutdown.
member.returns: The same owned immutable observation retained for all joining callers.
member.exception: The caller cancels its own wait.
member.remarks: The configured overall timeout is frozen at creation. UTC is an observation label; elapsed time is monotonic. At expiry, unstarted accepted records are abandoned. Cancellation of active writes/flushes is requested but is not guaranteed, and no new flush, retry or replacement writer starts. Completed means terminal dispositions, not successful delivery or resource release. A timed-out observation can retain pending I/O; its later completion does not change the cached result.

member.name: M:CIS.Logging.CoreLogRuntime.DisposeAsync
member.summary: Starts or joins the original bounded stop operation without a new drain window.
member.returns: A wait on the same shared operation; unsuccessful draining remains visible in LastStopResult.
member.remarks: Repeated disposal is harmless. At the original deadline this wait may complete while actual I/O and owned cleanup remain pending; no resource is disposed beneath active I/O. Inspect GetDiagnostics().LastStopResult for the immutable drain outcome.

member.name: M:CIS.Logging.CoreLogRuntime.FlushAsync(System.TimeSpan,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Waits through fixed accepted boundaries and confirms each enabled writer's buffer flush.
member.param: One positive finite overall wait budget; every positive TimeSpan is supported.
Cancels only this caller's wait, preserving shared worker requests.
member.returns: An owned immutable observation, including unresolved work at the deadline.
member.exception: The timeout is zero, negative or infinite.
The caller token is cancelled, including after boundary registration.
member.remarks: UTC labels are system observations; elapsed deadlines use the runtime TimeProvider. Flush does not stop admission or guarantee disk durability. After closure it cannot reopen a writer; a terminal writer returns an unavailable/failed flush even if the original stop flushed successfully. Inspect LastStopResult for that original shutdown outcome.

member.name: T:CIS.Logging.MicrosoftLogger.CoreLoggerProvider
member.summary: Creates Microsoft category loggers that borrow an application-owned core runtime.
member.remarks: Disposal disables this provider's future calls and never stops or disposes the shared runtime. A call already running when disposal occurs may finish. Category names follow the core component rules. Supplied rendered messages and exceptions enter core capture. Null or empty EventId.Name becomes log.message; EventId.Id supplies the integer attribute event_id, including zero and negative values. Structured state preserves {OriginalFormat} without parsing. Core checks interest before invoking formatter or copying state; full queues remain interested. Formatter exceptions propagate unchanged; invalid retained payload increments core diagnostics without output admission. Oversized valid payload is truncated. Disposed, stopped, filtered and all-faulted calls skip both callbacks after argument guards. Healthy outputs admit independently. Provider-created scopes are copied at BeginScope; borrowed host scopes are copied during accepted capture, after Activity and clock snapshots. Combined scope depth is 32.
